Your bedsheet set and pillowcases are marked as received back, but the wool blanket is not. A refund for the whole order cannot proceed until the blanket is received back (refund-policy/v1/return).

Would you like me to request a refund for just the bedsheet set and pillowcases for now?
Yes, please refund the bedsheet set and pillowcases for now. I’ll send the blanket back later.
